note: Recorded downstream connections for the pits inside the extent. Every path end carries a reason. No outlet is ever claimed: the extent contains no recorded outfall, endwall or discharge point, so a path that stops has reached the end of the record, not the end of the drainage system.

source.publisher: City of Melbourne Open Data Portal

terminations.no-recorded-connection: This pit has no downstream pipe in the council's record. That is where the record ends, not where the water does.
terminations.unrecorded-destination: A pipe leaves this pit, but the council's record does not say which pit it reaches.
terminations.leaves-mapped-area: The pipe continues to a recorded pit outside the mapped area.
terminations.cycle-guard: The recorded connections loop back on themselves here, so the path cannot be followed further.
